description: This file contains utility methods for parsing JSON responses from PayPal's API, focusing on extracting specific fields such as access tokens, IDs, and authorization IDs.

classes.name: PayPalResponseParsers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing specific data fields from PayPal JSON responses.

methods.name: extractAccessToken
methods.description: Extracts the access token from a raw JSON response string.

methods.name: extractId
methods.description: Extracts the ID from a raw JSON response string.

methods.name: extractAuthorizationId
methods.description: Extracts the authorization ID from a PayPal response JSON, navigating nested paths.

methods.name: readField
methods.description: Helper method that reads a specific field value from a JSON response string.
